title: First Lessons: Steel
introNarration: Mentor Edge keeps the hearth dummy in sight. Mail hangs in a neat row, oiled and unromantic. The air smells of metal, leather, and linseed. "Look around this hearth. Name the stance before you swing. Defeat the hearth dummy in this room — not Flint's orchard dummy. Then come back and talk to me. I will ink three leaves in your Field Primer."
reminderNarration: Look around this hearth. Defeat the hearth dummy here. Then talk to Edge. The anvil is still bright from honest work.
completionNarration: Edge inks three starter leaves at rank 1. A smear of oil darkens one corner of the page. The next lesson will ask you to cast.

objectives.label: Return and talk to Mentor Edge.
